title: How Do U.S. Firms Withstand Foreign Industrial Policies?
title_zh: 美国企业如何抵御外国产业政策？
title_primary: 美国企业如何抵御外国产业政策？
title_secondary: How Do U.S. Firms Withstand Foreign Industrial Policies?
authors: Xiao Cen, Vyacheslav Fos, Wei Jiang, William Parker, Johannes Spinnewijn
official: 官方在线 2025-05-23 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: This paper is the first to examine how China’s Five-Year Plans ("Plans'") affect the production allocation of U.S. firms. The Plans represent the highest level of China’s industrial policy, identifying key sectors for state support. Using the U.S. Census Longitudinal Business Database and Plans issued in 2001, 2006, 2011, and 2016, we find significant production displacement among U.S. industries operating in the same sectors targeted by the Plans in China. Over the five years following a sector’s inclusion in a Plan, the corresponding U.S. industries experience a 3.6% reduction in output, a 5.1% drop in employment, a 6.1% decrease in investment, and a 1.0% uptick in factory closure rates. These effects were neither anticipated by the stock market nor reflected in forward-looking firm decisions such as investment and job postings at the time. Some U.S. firms, however, successfully adapt by reallocating production toward "beneficiary" industries — those upstream or downstream of the targeted sectors — or by offshoring to the favored sectors within China. Such adjustments are enabled by preexisting productivity, sectoral and geographic footprints, financial access, and labor market flexibility. This study contributes to the ongoing policy debate on how best to support domestic firms and the broader economy in the face of global shocks, particularly those driven by foreign government intervention.
abstract_zh: 本文首次考察中国五年规划（“规划”）如何影响美国企业的生产配置。规划代表了中国产业政策的最高层级，明确了国家支持的关键行业。利用美国人口普查纵向商业数据库及2001年、2006年、2011年和2016年发布的规划，我们发现，在中国规划所针对的同一行业内运营的美国产业，出现了显著的生产转移现象。在某一行业被纳入规划后的五年内，相应的美国产业产出下降3.6%，就业减少5.1%，投资下滑6.1%，工厂关闭率上升1.0%。这些效应既未被股市提前预期，也未在当时反映在投资和职位发布等前瞻性企业决策中。然而，部分美国企业通过将生产重新配置至“受益”行业——即目标行业的上游或下游行业——或将生产外包至中国受扶持的行业，成功实现了适应。这种调整得益于企业既有的生产率、行业和地理布局、融资渠道以及劳动力市场灵活性。本研究为当前关于如何在全球冲击（尤其是外国政府干预引发的冲击）下更好地支持国内企业和整体经济的政策辩论提供了参考。

title: “Tiger‐hunting” and life satisfaction: A matter of trust
title_zh: 猎虎”与生活满意度：信任的作用
title_primary: 猎虎”与生活满意度：信任的作用
title_secondary: “Tiger‐hunting” and life satisfaction: A matter of trust
authors: Youxing Zhang, Peter Howley, Clemens Hetschko
official: 官方在线 2026-08-19 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Through anti‐corruption prosecutions, governments will often look to publicly signal their efforts at tackling corruption as a way of garnering political support. Our analysis combines Chinese data on the public disclosures of anti‐corruption prosecutions and individual well‐being indicators to explore the effect of these efforts for subjective well‐being. We show that while such signals are intended to garner political support, they can inadvertently lower life satisfaction among citizens, especially when political trust is low. Overall, our analysis illustrates how public demonstrations of efforts aimed at addressing issues of concern, despite their intended positive political effects, can erode public well‐being and potentially backfire when trust in the government is weak.
abstract_zh: 通过反腐败起诉，政府往往寻求公开宣示其打击腐败的努力，以此获取政治支持。我们的分析结合了中国反腐败起诉公开披露的数据与个体福祉指标，探讨这些努力对主观幸福感的影响。我们表明，尽管此类信号旨在获取政治支持，但它们可能无意中降低公民的生活满意度，尤其是在政治信任度较低的情况下。总体而言，我们的分析揭示了，针对关切问题所采取努力的公开示范，尽管预期具有积极的政治效应，但在政府信任薄弱时，可能侵蚀公众福祉并可能适得其反。

title: Road to Resilience: Floods, Highways and Indian Informal Manufacturing
title_zh: 通往韧性之路：洪水、公路与印度非正规制造业
title_primary: 通往韧性之路：洪水、公路与印度非正规制造业
title_secondary: Road to Resilience: Floods, Highways and Indian Informal Manufacturing
authors: Dixit Poudel, Munisamy Gopinath
official: 官方在线 2026-08-18 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Road infrastructure is widely recognized as a driver of economic development, but can it also aid in disaster resilience? This study addresses the resilience question in the Indian context by examining the output effects of dual and staggered treatments: national highway construction – the Golden Quadrilateral, and the North-South and East-West highways – and extreme flood exposure. Employing a production-theoretic framework, this study focuses on India’s informal manufacturing, the largest in the world without any formal safety nets. It combines geospatially matched, staggered flood exposure data from the Dartmouth Flood Observatory with phased highway rollout timelines from the National Highways Authority of India and repeated cross-section plant-level survey data (1990–2016). Exploiting quasi-random variation in the timing of flood exposure and road construction, a stacked difference-in-differences design is implemented, matching treated districts to future-treated counterparts. Results show that floods significantly reduce gross output and value added, while access to completed highway segments nearly offsets the average 8 percent flood-related output loss through higher output and reduced input expenditures. These effects are magnified for plants that own transport assets, highlighting a complementarity between internal logistics and external infrastructure. Off-highway plants exhibit similar resilience only when they possess transport assets. Heterogeneity analysis by market orientation reveals that resilience benefits are higher among non-tradable industries through local market stabilization. These findings reveal that roads are not only engines of development but also critical to disaster resilience. Designing infrastructure with dual function—development and resilience—is essential for building a climate-smart and resilient economy.
abstract_zh: 公路基础设施被广泛认为是经济发展的驱动力，但它是否也能有助于灾害韧性？本研究通过考察双重且交错处理的产出效应来探讨印度背景下的韧性议题：国家公路建设——黄金四边形，以及南北和东西高速公路——与极端洪水暴露。采用生产理论框架，本研究聚焦于印度非正规制造业，这是全球最大的缺乏任何正式安全网的部门。研究将达特茅斯洪水观测站的地理空间匹配、交错洪水暴露数据与印度国家公路管理局的分阶段公路铺设时间线以及重复横截面企业层面调查数据（1990-2016年）相结合。利用洪水暴露和公路建设时间上的准随机变异，实施堆叠双重差分设计，将处理地区与未来处理的对照组进行匹配。结果表明，洪水显著降低了总产出和增加值，而通达已建成高速公路路段几乎抵消了平均8%的洪水相关产出损失，其机制是通过提高产出和减少投入支出。这些效应对于拥有运输资产的企业更为显著，凸显了内部物流与外部基础设施之间的互补性。不在公路沿线的企业仅在拥有运输资产时才表现出类似的韧性。按市场导向进行的异质性分析显示，非贸易行业通过本地市场稳定获得的韧性收益更高。这些发现表明，公路不仅是发展的引擎，也是灾害韧性的关键。设计兼具发展与韧性双重功能的基础设施，对于建设气候智慧和韧性经济至关重要。

title: Platform Traps
title_zh: 平台陷阱
title_primary: 平台陷阱
title_secondary: Platform Traps
authors: Hagiu, Andrei, Wright, Julian
official: 来源期次 American Economic Journal: Microeconomics · 来源：期刊官网
abstract: A novel feature of platforms such as marketplaces and social networks is that nonparticipants may become worse off as others join. We show that in such settings, rational agents can be induced to join a platform despite being better off without it—a phenomenon we call a platform trap. We provide a theory of how platform traps emerge through one or more of the following additional features: (i) the ability of the platform to make dynamic price adjustments; (ii) the interplay between on-platform and off-platform negative externalities; (iii) favorable equilibrium selection in settings where participation decisions admit multiple equilibria.
abstract_zh: 平台（如市场和社会网络）的一个新颖特征是，非参与者可能因他人加入而境况恶化。我们证明，在此类情境下，理性个体即便在无平台时境况更佳，也可能被诱导加入平台——我们将此现象称为“平台陷阱”。我们提供了一种理论，阐述平台陷阱如何通过以下一个或多个附加特征形成：（i）平台进行动态价格调整的能力；（ii）平台内外负外部性的相互作用；（iii）在参与决策允许多重均衡的情境中，有利的均衡选择。

title: Heterogeneous climate risks for China's GI products under the China-EU Agreement: Disentangling effects across product categories and protection boundaries?
title_zh: 《中欧协定下中国地理标志产品的异质性气候风险：产品类别与保护边界的效应分解》
title_primary: 《中欧协定下中国地理标志产品的异质性气候风险：产品类别与保护边界的效应分解》
title_secondary: Heterogeneous climate risks for China's GI products under the China-EU Agreement: Disentangling effects across product categories and protection boundaries?
authors: Yiying Hong, Zhenbang Ma, Sijian Wang, Ruisi Luo, Yipeng Wang 等
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-08-03 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Agri-food products with geographical indications (GI products) are territorially embedded agricultural systems whose production and value depend on legally defined protection boundaries, rendering them biophysically vulnerable to climate change. Despite extensive examination of terroir-associated climate risks, the heterogeneous climate-driven potential land-use risks across product categories and protection boundaries remain insufficiently understood. Based on 7260 planting occurrence records, this study employs the MaxEnt model to conduct an exploratory simulation of shifts in the suitable areas for 185 Chinese GI products across seven categories under the China-EU GI Agreement. Consequently, it identifies high-risk GI products/categories, assesses their potential sensitivity and pressures from intra- and extra-zone exposure disparities under future climate scenarios. This study addresses three core questions: (i) identifying key environmental variables; (ii) assessing the potential climate sensitivity of specific categories; and (iii) quantifying potential intra- and extra-zone exposure pressures. Results demonstrate that (1) climatic factors constitute the primary biophysical drivers of GI product suitability, followed by topographic and soil factors; (2) Tea & Coffee products exhibit the highest potential climate sensitivity among all categories, while 35 identified high-sensitivity GI products face significant suitable area change or displacement risks; and (3) under future climate scenarios, the potential legal exposure induced by suitability expansion outside designated GI zones is projected to be approximately twice that of the potential moral hazard to product quality arising from environmental mismatches inside, underscoring a profound spatial mismatch between shifting ecological niches and static institutional boundaries. These findings highlight emerging land-use and institutional governance challenges for GI systems under climate change, offering policy insights for empowering entrepreneurial resilience, implementing category-specific interventions, and dynamically adjusting GI protection boundaries.
abstract_zh: 具有地理标志的农产品（GI产品）是根植于特定地域的农业系统，其生产和价值依赖于法律界定的保护边界，因此在生物物理层面易受气候变化影响。尽管关于风土相关气候风险的研究已较为广泛，但不同产品类别及保护边界内由气候驱动的潜在土地利用风险的异质性仍未得到充分理解。基于7260条种植发生记录，本研究采用MaxEnt模型，对中国-欧盟GI协定下七大类185种中国GI产品适宜区变化进行了探索性模拟。据此，识别出高风险GI产品/类别，并评估其在未来气候情景下因区内与区外暴露差异而产生的潜在敏感性与压力。本研究回应三个核心问题：（i）识别关键环境变量；（ii）评估特定类别的潜在气候敏感性；（iii）量化区内与区外潜在暴露压力。结果表明：（1）气候因素是GI产品适宜性的首要生物物理驱动因子，其次为地形和土壤因素；（2）茶与咖啡类产品在所有类别中表现出最高的潜在气候敏感性，而识别出的35种高敏感性GI产品面临显著的适宜区变化或位移风险；（3）在未来气候情景下，因适宜区扩展至指定GI区域之外而引发的潜在法律暴露预计约为因区内环境错配导致产品质量潜在道德风险的2倍，凸显了生态位迁移与静态制度边界之间的深刻空间错配。这些发现揭示了气候变化下GI系统面临的新兴土地利用与制度治理挑战，为增强创业韧性、实施类别差异化干预及动态调整GI保护边界提供了政策启示。

title: Credit Surfaces and Economic Uncertainty
title_zh: 信用曲面与经济不确定性
title_primary: 信用曲面与经济不确定性
title_secondary: Credit Surfaces and Economic Uncertainty
authors: John Geanakoplos, David E. Rappoport
official: 聚合元数据日期 2026-07-01 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: The Credit Surface along the leverage dimension gives the bond spread as a function of the loan-to-value ratio. Empirically, we show that uncertainty shocks typically increase spreads and steepen the credit surface, profoundly affecting the supply of credit. Theoretically, we derive necessary and sufficient conditions for the convexity of the credit surface, and for changes in the anticipated distribution of collateral prices that lead to steepening of the credit surface. Finally, we show that the credit surface itself fully reveals the entire distribution of collateral prices, thus providing a new and vivid language with which to describe uncertainty and stochastic orders. Credit surface steepening itself is a new stochastic order that may better capture our intuitive notion of more uncertainty.
abstract_zh: 沿杠杆维度的信用曲面将债券利差表示为贷款价值比的函数。实证上，我们表明不确定性冲击通常会提高利差并使信用曲面变得更加陡峭，深刻影响信贷供给。理论上，我们推导出信用曲面凸性的充分必要条件，以及预期抵押品价格分布变化导致信用曲面陡峭化的条件。最后，我们证明信用曲面本身完全揭示了抵押品价格的整个分布，从而为描述不确定性和随机序提供了一种新颖而生动的语言。信用曲面陡峭化本身是一种新的随机序，可能更好地捕捉我们对更多不确定性的直觉概念。

title: On the repeated volunteer’s dilemma with equal cost sharing
title_zh: 关于成本均摊下的重复志愿者困境
title_primary: 关于成本均摊下的重复志愿者困境
title_secondary: On the repeated volunteer’s dilemma with equal cost sharing
authors: Rabah Amir, Huizhong Liu, Tatiana Mayskaya, Jingwen Tian
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-30 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: We study the symmetric volunteer’s dilemma with binary actions and cost sharing, where the volunteering cost is split equally among volunteers. In the one-shot game, all pure-strategy Nash equilibria involve a single volunteer, while Pareto optimality allows any non-zero number. In the infinitely repeated game, all Pareto optima can be sustained in a subgame-perfect Nash equilibrium based on a grim-trigger strategy: trivially under undiscounted payoffs, and provided the discount factor exceeds a threshold under discounted payoffs. This threshold is non-monotonic in the number of volunteers; it is zero with one volunteer, highest with two, and decreases with both more volunteers beyond two and more players. Thus, the scope for tacit cooperation is universal with one volunteer, minimal with two, then improving as more join in, all the way to universal again only in the limit with more and more players and volunteers. Considering efficiency, scope for cooperation and equity/focality as criteria, the grand coalition of volunteers emerges as the best cooperation scenario.
abstract_zh: 我们研究了具有二元行动和成本分担的对称志愿者困境，其中志愿者成本由所有志愿者平均分担。在一次性博弈中，所有纯策略纳什均衡都只涉及一名志愿者，而帕累托最优则允许任意非零数量的志愿者。在无限重复博弈中，所有帕累托最优状态都可以通过基于冷酷触发策略的子博弈完美纳什均衡得以维持：在无折现收益下显然成立，而在有折现收益下，需满足折现因子超过某一阈值。该阈值随志愿者数量呈非单调变化：当只有一名志愿者时为零，两名志愿者时最高，随后随着志愿者数量超过两人以及玩家数量增加而下降。因此，隐性合作的范围在只有一名志愿者时具有普遍性，在两名志愿者时最小，随着更多人加入而改善，直到在玩家和志愿者数量趋于极限时再次达到普遍性。综合考虑效率、合作范围以及公平性/焦点性等标准，志愿者的大联盟成为最佳合作情景。

title: Farm Size, Technical Efficiency, and Environmental Performance: Evidence From Rice Production in China
title_zh: 农场规模、技术效率与环境绩效：来自中国水稻生产的证据
title_primary: 农场规模、技术效率与环境绩效：来自中国水稻生产的证据
title_secondary: Farm Size, Technical Efficiency, and Environmental Performance: Evidence From Rice Production in China
authors: Bin Lin, Xiaoxi Wang, Bernhard Dalheimer, Bernhard Brümmer
official: 官方在线 2026-07-30 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Farm size, as well as technical and environmental efficiency in agriculture, is key to food security and sustainable development. However, empirical evidence about how heterogeneity across farm sizes is associated with the joint production of desirable outputs and undesirable by‐products remains limited, preventing our understanding of technical and environmental efficiency. Using country‐representative survey data on rice production in China from 2014 to 2018, we estimate farm‐level technical and environmental efficiency by employing a by‐production function combined with a stochastic meta‐frontier approach, accounting for heterogeneous technology across farm sizes. Our findings reveal considerable room to improve both technical and environmental performance, and the extent of both differs markedly by farm size. Medium‐sized farms (2–6.67 ha) exhibit the highest meta‐frontier technical efficiency, whereas large farms (6.67–33.33 ha) achieve the highest meta‐frontier environmental efficiency. The estimated shadow prices indicate that the mean marginal abatement cost of nitrogen pollution is 129.233 yuan/kg. We also identify a range of farm‐scale factors, such as technical training, land consolidation, higher educational attainment, and cooperative membership, which are significantly associated with higher levels of technical and environmental efficiency in rice farming. Counterfactual simulations further indicate that combining farm‐size‐specific measures could enhance meta‐frontier technical and environmental efficiency. In particular, cooperative participation is positively associated with technical and environmental performance among smallholders, while high‐level education and technical training are more impactful at large farms. Land fragmentation is consistently associated with lower efficiency and wider technology gaps across farm sizes. Our findings underscore the importance of designing farm‐size‐specific policies and implementing integrated interventions in promoting sustainable agricultural development.
abstract_zh: 农业经营规模以及技术效率与环境效率是粮食安全与可持续发展的关键。然而，关于不同规模农场在联合生产期望产出与非期望副产品方面的异质性如何影响技术效率与环境效率，现有实证证据仍然有限，这制约了我们对相关问题的理解。利用2014年至2018年中国水稻生产的全国代表性调查数据，我们采用联合生产函数结合随机元前沿方法，在考虑不同规模农场技术异质性的基础上，估算了农场层面的技术效率与环境效率。研究结果表明，技术绩效与环境绩效均有较大提升空间，且不同规模农场的提升幅度存在显著差异。中型农场（2–6.67公顷）的元前沿技术效率最高，而大型农场（6.67–33.33公顷）的元前沿环境效率最高。估算的影子价格显示，氮污染的平均边际减排成本为129.233元/千克。我们还发现一系列农场规模相关因素，如技术培训、土地整合、更高教育水平及合作社成员身份，与水稻种植中更高的技术效率与环境效率显著相关。反事实模拟进一步表明，结合针对特定规模农场的措施可提升元前沿技术效率与环境效率。具体而言，合作社参与与小农户的技术绩效和环境绩效呈正相关，而高等教育水平和技术培训对大型农场的影响更为显著。土地细碎化则始终与较低效率及更大技术差距相关，且这一关联在不同规模农场中普遍存在。研究结果强调了制定针对不同规模农场的政策并实施综合干预措施对促进农业可持续发展的重要性。

title: Rural Electrification in the Brazilian Amazon
title_zh: 巴西亚马逊地区的农村电气化
title_primary: 巴西亚马逊地区的农村电气化
title_secondary: Rural Electrification in the Brazilian Amazon
authors: Laura Villalobos, Jill Caviglia-Harris, Daniel Harris, Elaine Frey
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-26 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Rural electrification is widely promoted to improve livelihoods, yet its land-use consequences in forest frontiers remain unclear. Using longitudinal household surveys linked to property boundaries and satellite land cover in the Brazilian Amazon, we apply heterogeneity-robust staggered-adoption difference-in-differences. Electrification increases cattle income over the medium term but has no detectable effect on annual property-level deforestation. Income gains appear to reflect herd expansion on existing pasture and a modest refrigerated-milk price premium rather than higher per-animal productivity.
abstract_zh: 农村电气化被广泛推广以改善生计，但其在森林前沿地区的土地利用后果仍不明确。利用与巴西亚马逊地区财产边界及卫星土地覆盖数据相关联的纵向家庭调查，我们采用了异质性稳健的分阶段采用双重差分法。电气化在中期内增加了养牛收入，但对年度财产层面的森林砍伐无显著影响。收入增长似乎源于现有牧场的牛群扩张以及适度的冷藏牛奶价格溢价，而非单头动物生产力的提升。

title: Species-specific wildlife recreation demand
title_zh: 物种特异性野生动物休闲需求
title_primary: 物种特异性野生动物休闲需求
title_secondary: Species-specific wildlife recreation demand
authors: Peri M. Brimley, Todd L. Cherry, John Whitehead
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-26 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: The wildlife valuation literature largely focuses on eliciting willingness-to-pay for wildlife conservation, not recreation, and frequently groups species together under the banner of “wildlife”. This study employs the contingent valuation method to value the likelihood of viewing specific wildlife in Grand Teton National Park (GTNP). We estimate willingness-to-pay (WTP) and willingness-to-accept (WTA) for species-specific recreation trips to explore substitutability between popular wildlife species. Estimates across species better equip wildlife managers to balance the inherent tradeoffs associated with climate impacts on habitats and populations as well as changing interests among recreationists.
abstract_zh: 野生动物价值评估文献主要关注的是为野生动物保护（而非休闲娱乐）而引致的支付意愿，且常将不同物种笼统归为“野生动物”范畴。本研究采用条件价值评估法，对在大提顿国家公园观赏特定野生动物的概率进行价值评估。我们估算了针对特定物种的休闲旅行支付意愿与接受意愿，以探究热门野生动物物种之间的可替代性。跨物种的估算结果能更好地帮助野生动物管理者平衡气候变化对栖息地与种群造成的固有权衡，以及休闲者兴趣变化带来的影响。

title: Public Debt and Redistribution with Borrowing Constraints
title_zh: 借贷约束下的公共债务与再分配
title_primary: 借贷约束下的公共债务与再分配
title_secondary: Public Debt and Redistribution with Borrowing Constraints
authors: Florin Bilbiie, Tommaso Monacelli, Roberto Perotti
official: 官方在线 2012-08-12 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: We build a model with financial imperfections and heterogeneous agents and analyse the effects of two types of fiscal policy: revenue‐neutral, intratemporal redistribution; and debt‐financed tax cuts, which we interpret as intertemporal redistribution. Under flexible prices, the two policies are either neutral or display effects that are at odds with the empirical evidence. With sticky prices, Ricardian equivalence always fails. A Robin Hood, revenue‐neutral redistribution to borrowers is expansionary on aggregate activity. A uniform, debt‐financed tax cut has a positive present‐value multiplier on consumption, stemming from intertemporal substitution by the savers, who hold the public debt.
abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个包含金融摩擦与异质性主体的模型，并分析了两种财政政策的效果：收入中性的期内再分配政策，以及以债务融资减税为代表的跨期再分配政策。在弹性价格条件下，这两种政策要么呈现中性，要么表现出与实证证据相悖的效应。而在粘性价格条件下，李嘉图等价始终失效。针对借款者的罗宾汉式收入中性再分配政策对总体经济活动具有扩张效应。统一实施的债务融资减税政策对消费产生正向现值乘数，这一效应源于持有公共债务的储蓄者的跨期替代行为。

title: Spillover Effects in Complementary Markets: A Study of the Indian Cell Phone and Wireless Service Markets
title_zh: 互补市场中的溢出效应：印度手机与无线服务市场研究
title_primary: 互补市场中的溢出效应：印度手机与无线服务市场研究
title_secondary: Spillover Effects in Complementary Markets: A Study of the Indian Cell Phone and Wireless Service Markets
authors: Chirantan Chatterjee, Ying Fan, Debi Prasad Mohapatra
official: 官方在线 2026-07-21 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: This paper studies how spillovers across complementary markets shape product variety and firm entry. We examine the Indian cell phone and wireless service markets during the 4G rollout and estimate a structural model of demand, pricing, carrier network expansion, and phone product choice. The estimation results support the economic forces through which complementarity generates spillovers. Counterfactual simulations show that banning budget Chinese phones slows 4G deployment by roughly five quarters and lowers consumer welfare without raising domestic firms' profits. Similarly, an unrestricted subsidy outperforms a domestic-only subsidy in expanding network coverage, increasing consumer welfare, and raising domestic firms' profits.
abstract_zh: 本文研究互补市场间的溢出效应如何影响产品多样性与企业进入。我们以印度4G网络部署期间的手机与无线服务市场为研究对象，构建了涵盖需求、定价、运营商网络扩张及手机产品选择的结构模型。估计结果证实了互补性产生溢出效应的经济机制。反事实模拟表明：禁止廉价中国手机将使4G部署延迟约五个季度，并降低消费者福利，但不会提升本土企业利润；同样，无限制补贴在扩大网络覆盖、提升消费者福利及增加本土企业利润方面均优于仅限本土企业的补贴方案。

title: Gender Norms and the Quantity-Quality Tradeoff: Evidence from Free Primary Education in Africa
title_zh: 性别规范与数量-质量权衡：来自非洲免费初等教育的证据
title_primary: 性别规范与数量-质量权衡：来自非洲免费初等教育的证据
title_secondary: Gender Norms and the Quantity-Quality Tradeoff: Evidence from Free Primary Education in Africa
authors: Collins, Matthew, Guarnieri, Eleonora, Rainer, Helmut
official: 官方在线 2026-07-20 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: This paper investigates the impact of free primary education (FPE) on parents' fertility decisions in sub-Saharan Africa and how these effects depend on prevailing gender norms. Leveraging the staggered rollout of FPE across 17 countries and a within-ethnicity design, we find that the reform reduced completed fertility by 0.25 births per woman. Reduced fertility coincides with both improved child survival and school enrollment. Linking these data with ethnic-level cultural norms of male dominance, we show that these effects arise exclusively among groups with low male dominance. Consistent with fertility reductions increasing women's autonomy, FPE also strengthens women's outside options and intra-household bargaining power. In low male-dominance settings, this is reflected in higher divorce probabilities, lower acceptance of intimate partner violence, greater participation in household decisions, and increased media engagement - changes absent in high male-dominance cultures. A simple model embedding the quantity - quality tradeoff within a limited-commitment household bargaining framework, where gender norms determine women's veto power over fertility, rationalizes these findings. Overall, the results underscore the central role of gender norms in shaping the effects of policy interventions on fertility and broader development outcomes.
abstract_zh: 本文研究了撒哈拉以南非洲地区免费初等教育（FPE）对父母生育决策的影响，以及这些效应如何受主流性别规范的调节。利用17个国家分阶段推行FPE的政策差异及族群内部设计，我们发现该改革使每位女性的完成生育数减少0.25个。生育率下降与儿童存活率提升及入学率提高同步发生。通过将数据与反映男性主导地位的族群文化规范相关联，我们发现这些效应仅出现在男性主导程度较低的群体中。与生育率下降增强女性自主权相一致，FPE还提升了女性的外部选择权和家庭内部议价能力。在低男性主导环境中，这体现为离婚概率上升、对亲密伴侣暴力的接受度降低、家庭决策参与度提高以及媒体接触增加——而在高男性主导文化中则未观察到这些变化。一个嵌入数量-质量权衡且受有限承诺家庭议价框架约束的简单模型（其中性别规范决定女性对生育的否决权）可合理解释上述发现。总体而言，研究结果凸显了性别规范在塑造政策干预对生育及更广泛发展成果影响中的核心作用。

title: 中国省域农业资本投资回报率测算——兼论社会资本持续投资农业的动因

title: Research value-added in elite economics PhD programmes
title_zh: 精英经济学博士项目的研究附加值
title_primary: 精英经济学博士项目的研究附加值
title_secondary: Research value-added in elite economics PhD programmes
authors: Joshua Angrist, Marc Diederichs, Glenn Ellison
official: 官方在线 2026-07-01 · 来源：RSS
abstract: The 2025 US university endowment tax hike, together with other financial pressures, is pushing the wealthiest universities to shrink their doctoral cohorts. This column exploits a novel sample of MIT Economics PhD applicants to shed light on the research value-added of elite doctoral programmes and the possible consequences of programme cutbacks. Holding applicant ability fixed, graduates of high-tax and other elite schools produce 60-75% more impact-weighted publications than comparable applicants. Neither peer effects nor home-journal favouritism explains this advantage. If elite PhD programmes add similar value in other disciplines, the endowment tax may well slow the pace of scientific progress.
abstract_zh: 2025年美国大学捐赠税上调，叠加其他财务压力，正迫使最富有的大学缩减博士生招生规模。本文利用麻省理工学院经济学博士申请者的新颖样本，揭示了精英博士项目的研究附加值以及项目缩减可能带来的后果。在控制申请者能力不变的情况下，高税负及其他精英学校的毕业生所产出的影响力加权论文数量，比同类申请者高出60%至75%。这种优势既不能用同伴效应解释，也不能用本校期刊偏好解释。如果精英博士项目在其他学科也能带来类似的附加值，那么捐赠税很可能会减缓科学进步的步伐。

title: Institutional Synergies and the Fragility of Loan Funds
title_zh: 制度协同与贷款基金的脆弱性

title_secondary: Institutional Synergies and the Fragility of Loan Funds
authors: Mustafa Emin, Christopher James, Tao Li, Jing Lu
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-03 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: There are two major institutional investors in the syndicated loan market: collateralized loan obligations (CLOs) and loan mutual funds. CLOs are closed-end funds while loan funds are open-end funds that issue claims that are redeemable on demand. In this paper, we examine whether CLOs provide arbitrage capital that contributes to the resilience of loan funds. We find that CLOs act as shock absorbers, providing liquidity through par-building trades when loan funds experience large outflows. However, CLO-provided liquidity is limited to par build–eligible loans, leading to potential flow-induced fire sales among par build–ineligible loans. (JEL G23, G38
abstract_zh: 摘要银团贷款市场中有两类主要机构投资者：担保贷款凭证（CLOs）和贷款共同基金。CLO属于封闭式基金，而贷款基金则是开放式基金，其发行的份额可随时赎回。本文考察CLO是否提供套利资本，从而增强贷款基金的韧性。研究发现，当贷款基金遭遇大规模资金外流时，CLO通过平价构建交易提供流动性，起到缓冲器作用。然而，CLO提供的流动性仅限于符合平价构建条件的贷款，这可能导致不符合条件的贷款因资金流动压力而被迫折价抛售。（JEL G23, G38）

title: The Long Tail Wags the Dog: Platform Design and Bargaining with Majors
title_zh: 长尾摇动狗：平台设计与主要参与者的议价
title_primary: 长尾摇动狗：平台设计与主要参与者的议价
title_secondary: The Long Tail Wags the Dog: Platform Design and Bargaining with Majors
authors: Gaston Llanes, Martin Peitz
official: 官方在线 2026-06-30 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: We study a platform that interacts with a major content provider, a long tail of independent providers, and consumers who allocate attention across competing content. By designing independent-provider compensation, the platform endogenously shapes its outside option and disciplines the major. This strategic use of long-tail compensation distorts entry relative to the first best. Allowing the platform to steer consumer attention improves entry incentives conditional on compensation, but affects bargaining incentives, and may thus increase or decrease welfare. We then consider regulation, showing that conservative minimum-compensation floors robustly improve welfare, while non-discrimination policies have ambiguous welfare effects.
abstract_zh: 我们研究了一个平台，该平台与一个主要内容提供商、众多独立提供商（长尾）以及在不同竞争内容间分配注意力的消费者进行互动。通过设计对独立提供商的补偿机制，平台内生地塑造了其外部选择，并对主要提供商形成约束。这种对长尾补偿的策略性运用，相对于最优状态扭曲了市场进入。允许平台引导消费者注意力，在给定补偿条件下改善了进入激励，但会影响议价激励，从而可能增加或减少社会福利。随后我们考虑监管问题，发现保守的最低补偿下限能稳健地提升社会福利，而非歧视性政策则具有模糊的福利效应。

title: Keeping Pace or Falling Behind? The Depth of Latin American Trade Agreements
title_zh: 保持同步还是落后？拉丁美洲贸易协定的深度
title_primary: 保持同步还是落后？拉丁美洲贸易协定的深度
title_secondary: Keeping Pace or Falling Behind? The Depth of Latin American Trade Agreements
authors: Raphael Gomes da Silva, Fernanda Aparecida Silva, Lia Nogueira
official: 官方在线 2026-06-22 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This article examines whether Latin American countries are keeping pace with global trends in trade agreement depth or falling behind. Using 681 agreements (1970–2019), we develop the Depth Index of Trade Agreements (DITA) to weight provisions endogenously through factor analysis based on co‐occurrence patterns. Results show that the Pacific Alliance and Central America lag one decade behind North American standards, whereas South America and the Caribbean lag by two to three decades. Partner selection is critical: countries negotiating extensively with developed partners tend to incorporate similar provisions into South–South agreements, suggesting North–South spillover effects. These findings suggest that regional lag reflects policy choices rather than inherent constraints.
abstract_zh: 本文考察拉丁美洲国家在全球贸易协定深度趋势中是同步跟进还是落后。基于681项协定（1970-2019年），我们通过因子分析依据条款共现模式内生性加权，构建了贸易协定深度指数（DITA）。结果显示，太平洋联盟和中美洲落后于北美标准约十年，而南美洲和加勒比地区则落后二至三十年。合作伙伴选择至关重要：与发达国家进行广泛谈判的国家，倾向于将类似条款纳入南南协定中，这表明存在南北溢出效应。这些发现表明，区域滞后反映的是政策选择而非固有约束。

title: Monetary Policy and Growth in an Open Economy with the Spirit of Capitalism
title_zh: 资本主义精神下开放经济中的货币政策与增长
title_primary: 资本主义精神下开放经济中的货币政策与增长
title_secondary: Monetary Policy and Growth in an Open Economy with the Spirit of Capitalism
authors: Yang Ming, Minxian Sun, Chan Wang, Jingyi Wang
source: Journal of Economic Dynamics and Control
official: 官方在线 2026-06-20 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This paper studies optimal monetary policy in a two-country Schumpeterian growth model incorporating the spirit of capitalism (SOC). We analyze how the strength of SOC in each country shapes the incentives for and outcomes of international monetary policy cooperation. In our framework, monetary policy affects domestic productivity growth via cash-in-advance constraints on both consumption and R&D investment. We show analytically that stronger SOC in either country lowers the optimal cooperative nominal interest rate by increasing R&D-driven growth and cross-border spillovers. Calibrating the model to the U.S. and the Euro Area, we find that the optimal cooperative interest rates satisfy the Friedman rule, while the Nash-equilibrium interest rates are positive in both economies. Moreover, while policy cooperation yields welfare gains for both parties when SOC levels are similar, it generates welfare losses for the country with the weaker SOC when asymmetries are large. Our results highlight a novel mechanism: the feasibility and desirability of international monetary policy cooperation depend critically on the relative strengths of the SOC across countries.
abstract_zh: 本文在纳入资本主义精神（SOC）的两国熊彼特增长模型中研究最优货币政策。我们分析了各国SOC强度如何影响国际货币政策合作的激励与结果。在我们的框架中，货币政策通过消费和研发投资的现金预付约束影响国内生产率增长。我们分析表明，任一国家更强的SOC通过提升研发驱动增长和跨境溢出效应，降低了最优合作名义利率。将模型校准至美国和欧元区，我们发现最优合作利率满足弗里德曼规则，而纳什均衡利率在两国均为正。此外，当SOC水平相似时，政策合作为双方带来福利收益；但当不对称性较大时，合作对SOC较弱的国家产生福利损失。我们的结果突显了一个新颖机制：国际货币政策合作的可行性与可取性关键取决于各国SOC的相对强度。

title: The Feasibility of Household Food Waste Reduction in Finland: Insights From Five Consumer Profiles
title_zh: 芬兰家庭食物垃圾减量的可行性：基于五种消费者画像的洞察
title_primary: 芬兰家庭食物垃圾减量的可行性：基于五种消费者画像的洞察
title_secondary: The Feasibility of Household Food Waste Reduction in Finland: Insights From Five Consumer Profiles
authors: Aino Friman, Dušan Drabik
source: Australian Journal of Agricultural and Resource Economics
official: 官方在线 2026-06-11 · 来源：RSS
abstract: We apply a household production framework to analyse how changes in cooking skills, waste‐abatement costs and wage rates influence the food waste behaviour of five consumer profiles in Finland. We find that achieving a given reduction in food waste through skill‐enhancing interventions induces larger behavioural adjustments than equivalent reductions in waste‐abatement costs. Higher wage rates, however, counteract efforts to decrease household food waste. Lowering abatement costs at the food preparation stage yields a greater overall reduction in waste than targeting the consumption stage. Our findings indicate that uniform, skill‐based interventions are unlikely to be sustainable without complementary structural support tailored to specific consumer groups. Accordingly, policy measures should combine skill development with targeted reductions in the costs of preventing food waste.
abstract_zh: 我们运用家庭生产框架，分析烹饪技能变化、减废成本及工资率如何影响芬兰五类消费者群体的食物浪费行为。研究发现，通过技能提升干预实现特定程度的食物浪费减少，比同等程度的减废成本降低更能引发显著的行为调整。然而，更高的工资率会抵消减少家庭食物浪费的努力。相较于针对消费阶段，降低食物准备阶段的减废成本能带来更显著的总体浪费减少。研究结果表明，若缺乏针对特定消费者群体的结构性配套支持，单一化的技能干预措施难以持续。因此，政策制定应将技能培养与定向降低食物浪费预防成本相结合。

title: Distraction and Stock Return Synchronicity: Evidence from the Field
title_zh: 分心与股票回报同步性：来自实地证据
title_primary: 分心与股票回报同步性：来自实地证据
title_secondary: Distraction and Stock Return Synchronicity: Evidence from the Field
authors: Michael Ehrmann, David-Jan Jansen
official: 官方在线 2026-06-03 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: We study how fluctuations in investor attention affect stock return synchronicity. For a sample of 734 stocks from 19 countries, we document that synchronicity increases when international soccer matches distract investors, suggesting that investors pay less attention to firm-specific news. Next, we show that synchronicity increases even more as matches become more important and when the national team is (closely) trailing rather than when it is leading during a match. These results are in line with Kahneman’s (1973) capacity model of attention, with loss aversion and with a role for suspense and underscore how fluctuations in investor attention affect price formation.
abstract_zh: 我们研究了投资者注意力波动如何影响股票收益同步性。基于19个国家734只股票的样本，我们发现当国际足球比赛分散投资者注意力时，股票收益同步性会上升，这表明投资者对公司特定新闻的关注度降低。进一步研究表明，随着比赛重要性增加，以及当国家队在比赛中处于（微弱）落后而非领先状态时，同步性上升幅度更大。这些结果与卡尼曼（1973）的注意力容量模型、损失厌恶理论以及悬念的作用机制相吻合，并凸显了投资者注意力波动如何影响价格形成过程。

title: Identifying Preference for Early Resolution from Asset Prices
title_zh: 从资产价格中识别对早期解决的偏好
title_primary: 从资产价格中识别对早期解决的偏好
title_secondary: Identifying Preference for Early Resolution from Asset Prices
authors: Hengjie Ai, Ravi Bansal, Hongye Guo, Amir Yaron
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-06-01 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: This paper develops an asset market-based test for preference for the timing of resolution of uncertainty. Our main theorem provides a characterization of preference for early resolution of uncertainty in terms of the risk premium realized during the period when the informativeness of macroeconomic announcements is resolved. Empirically, we find support for preference for early resolution of uncertainty based on evidence on the dynamics of the implied volatility of S&P 500 index options before Federal Open Market Committee announcements. (JEL D81, D83, G13, G14, G41)
abstract_zh: 本文构建了一种基于资产市场的检验方法，用于评估不确定性解决时机偏好。核心定理表明，偏好不确定性尽早解决的特征可通过宏观经济公告信息释放期间所实现的风险溢价来刻画。基于联邦公开市场委员会公告发布前后标普500指数期权隐含波动率的动态证据，实证结果支持市场参与者存在偏好不确定性尽早解决的倾向。（JEL分类号：D81, D83, G13, G14, G41）

title: The two sides of migration in Central America: aggregate and distributional impacts in Guatemala
title_zh: 中美洲移民的两面性：危地马拉的总体与分配影响
title_primary: 中美洲移民的两面性：危地马拉的总体与分配影响
title_secondary: The two sides of migration in Central America: aggregate and distributional impacts in Guatemala
authors: Luis Escalante, Emerta Aragie, Manuel A. Hernandez
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-05-18 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: International migration affects labor supply, production patterns, and external income flows in origin countries, yet our understanding of its economy-wide and distributional consequences remains limited, particularly with regard to the role of return migration. This study integrates detailed microdata on migrant profiles into a general equilibrium model applied to Guatemala to examine how emigration and return migration affect macroeconomic performance, sectoral dynamics, and household welfare. We simulate three scenarios: a reference scenario reflecting recent-historical emigration patterns (MIG-0), a reduced-emigration scenario (MIG-1), and a net-return migration scenario (MIG-2), capturing recent shifts in emigration and return flows by skill level. Results reveal trade-offs between aggregate economic performance and distributional impacts across households. Compared to a baseline economy with no mobility, Gross Domestic Product (GDP) rises modestly under the reference scenario (+0.2 percent) and by additional 0.3–0.5 percentage points under the reduced-emigration and net-return scenarios, driven by expanded labor supply from returnees and currency depreciation. Non-agro-processing manufacturing shows the largest expansion (up to 1.8 percent), reflecting its strong labor-absorption potential. Household welfare, especially among remittance-dependent households, is highly sensitive to these flows, with income and consumption declining under the two counterfactual migration scenarios. These findings underscore the need for policies that facilitate returnee reintegration and strengthen social protection for remittance-dependent households, ensuring that the macroeconomic gains from migration adjustments translate into equitable welfare improvements.
abstract_zh: 国际移民影响来源国的劳动力供给、生产模式和外部收入流动，然而我们对其整体经济及分配后果的理解仍然有限，尤其是关于回流移民的作用。本研究将关于移民特征的详细微观数据整合到应用于危地马拉的一般均衡模型中，以考察移民出境和回流移民如何影响宏观经济表现、部门动态和家庭福利。我们模拟了三种情景：反映近期历史移民模式的参考情景（MIG-0）、移民减少情景（MIG-1）和净回流移民情景（MIG-2），捕捉了近期按技能水平划分的移民出境和回流流动的变化。结果揭示了总体经济表现与家庭间分配影响之间的权衡。与无流动性的基准经济相比，参考情景下国内生产总值（GDP）温和上升（+0.2%），在移民减少和净回流情景下进一步上升0.3–0.5个百分点，这得益于回流者带来的劳动力供给扩大和货币贬值。非农产品加工业扩张幅度最大（最高达1.8%），反映了其强大的劳动力吸收潜力。家庭福利，尤其是依赖汇款的家庭，对这些流动高度敏感，在两种反事实移民情景下，其收入和消费均出现下降。这些发现强调了制定促进回流者重新融入社会并加强对依赖汇款家庭社会保护政策的必要性，以确保移民调整带来的宏观经济收益转化为公平的福利改善。

title: The Impact of the Dodd-Frank Act on Acquisition Activity
title_zh: 多德-弗兰克法案对收购活动的影响
title_primary: 多德-弗兰克法案对收购活动的影响
title_secondary: The Impact of the Dodd-Frank Act on Acquisition Activity
authors: Anup Basnet, Magnus Blomkvist, Karl Felixson, Eva Liljeblom, Hitesh Vyas
official: 官方在线 2026-05-15 · 来源：RSS
abstract: The Dodd-Frank Act in 2010 increased ex ante downgrade threats without changing credit-rated firms’ underlying credit quality. We show that the act had negative impacts on credit-rated firms’ acquisition activities, especially among speculative-grade firms as they face greater downgrade-induced costs. The more selective acquisition strategies led to higher announcement returns and greater postacquisition upgrade probabilities. Consistent with firms refraining from taking on overall acquisition risk rather than financial risk, we show significant reductions in both cash-and stock-settled dealmaking after the Dodd-Frank Act. In sum, our study highlights that increased legal stringency on credit rating agencies has important spillover effects on firms’ mergers and acquisitions activities.
abstract_zh: 2010年的《多德-弗兰克法案》在不改变信用评级公司基础信用质量的情况下，增加了事前降级威胁。我们证明该法案对信用评级公司的收购活动产生了负面影响，尤其是在投机级公司中，因为它们面临更大的降级引发的成本。更为审慎的收购策略导致了更高的公告回报和更大的收购后升级概率。与公司避免承担整体收购风险而非财务风险的行为一致，我们发现在《多德-弗兰克法案》之后，现金结算和股票结算的交易活动均显著减少。总之，我们的研究强调，对信用评级机构加强法律约束对企业的并购活动具有重要的溢出效应。

title: Capital Income Taxation and Self‐Fulfilling Aggregate Instability
title_zh: 资本收入税与自我实现的总量不稳定性
title_primary: 资本收入税与自我实现的总量不稳定性
title_secondary: Capital Income Taxation and Self‐Fulfilling Aggregate Instability
authors: KEVIN X.D. HUANG, QINGLAI MENG, JIANPO XUE
source: Journal of Money, Credit and Banking
official: 官方在线 2026-04-30 · 来源：RSS
abstract: A general wisdom, since at least the work of Schmitt‐Grohé and Uribe (1997), holds that a government that relies on adjusting capital (rather than labor) income tax rate to balance its budget is immune to aggregate instability driven by self‐fulfilling expectations. This conventional wisdom is overturned in the present paper that augments the neoclassical framework with endogenous capital utilization. We show that the interaction between the capital tax rate and the capital utilization rate generates fiscal increasing returns and factor share redistribution to induce equilibrium indeterminacy. It is also shown that capital depreciation allowances can act as a stabilization device to preempt extrinsic instability. We demonstrate that self‐fulfilling instability can occur in real‐world economies, but that it can be prevented if capital depreciation allowance is combined with capital taxation to achieve budget objective.
abstract_zh: 至少自Schmitt-Grohé和Uribe（1997）的研究以来，普遍观点认为，依赖调整资本（而非劳动）所得税率以实现预算平衡的政府，能够免受由自我实现预期驱动的总体不稳定性影响。然而，本文通过在内生资本利用率的新古典框架中引入这一因素，颠覆了这一传统智慧。我们证明，资本税率与资本利用率之间的相互作用会产生财政规模收益递增和要素份额再分配，从而引发均衡不确定性。同时，研究还表明，资本折旧扣除可以作为稳定工具，以预防外部不确定性。我们论证，自我实现的不稳定性可能出现在现实经济中，但若将资本折旧扣除与资本税收相结合以实现预算目标，则可避免此类不稳定性。

title: Dynamics and sources of wage inequality in Taiwan: Evidence from employer‐employee matched data
title_zh: 台湾工资不平等的动态与来源：基于雇主-雇员匹配数据的证据
title_primary: 台湾工资不平等的动态与来源：基于雇主-雇员匹配数据的证据
title_secondary: Dynamics and sources of wage inequality in Taiwan: Evidence from employer‐employee matched data
authors: Po‐Chun Huang, Huei‐Ming Chen, Hsien‐Ming Lien, Tzu‐Ting Yang
official: 官方在线 2026-04-14 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This paper studies the decline in wage inequality in Taiwan from 2004 to 2019 using administrative employer-employee matched data and the Abowd–Kramarz–Margolis (AKM) framework. Unlike the U.S. and Europe, Taiwan experienced an 8.4% drop in wage inequality, driven largely by reductions in within-firm disparities. Minimum wage hikes likely contributed to this compression, as lower-tail inequality declined due to faster earnings growth among low-wage workers, while upper-tail inequality remained relatively stable. AKM estimates, robust to bias correction, indicate that firm-specific wage premiums account for a small share of inequality, while worker-firm sorting has become increasingly important in explaining wage dispersion.
abstract_zh: 本文利用行政雇主-雇员匹配数据及Abowd–Kramarz–Margolis（AKM）框架，研究了2004年至2019年间台湾工资不平等程度的下降现象。与美国和欧洲不同，台湾的工资不平等程度下降了8.4%，这一变化主要源于企业内部差异的缩减。最低工资上调很可能促成了这种压缩效应，因为低工资工人收入增长更快导致下尾不平等程度降低，而上尾不平等程度则相对稳定。经偏差校正后依然稳健的AKM估计表明，企业特定工资溢价在不平等中占比较小，而工人与企业之间的匹配效应在解释工资离散度方面日益重要。

title: Structural breaks, model uncertainty and factor selection
title_zh: 结构突变、模型不确定性与因子选择
title_primary: 结构突变、模型不确定性与因子选择
title_secondary: Structural breaks, model uncertainty and factor selection
authors: Siddhartha Chib, Simon C. Smith
official: 官方在线 2025-08-06 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This paper addresses the non-standard problem of detecting multiple structural breaks when the data-generating model in each regime is uncertain, with an application to factor selection in empirical asset pricing. Detection is based on the marginal likelihood of break points, obtained by a novel integration over all possible pairings of models across regimes, from all possible models within regimes. The optimal break points maximize this marginal likelihood. Applying this method to the six Fama–French factors on monthly data from 1963–2023, the analysis identifies three breaks – 1982, 1998, and 2009 – and a shift toward more parsimonious models after 1998. Before 1998, five or six factors are selected, but two afterward. Thus, with breaks, there is a move to parsimony, which has implications for the factor zoo literature. Moreover, within each regime, all omitted factors are spanned by the ones selected. Incorporating breaks also leads to substantially different weight allocations in the maximum Sharpe ratio risk factor portfolio.
abstract_zh: 本文探讨了当每个制度下的数据生成模型不确定时，检测多重结构断点的非标准问题，并将其应用于实证资产定价中的因子选择。检测基于断点的边际似然，通过一种新颖的积分方法，对所有可能的跨制度模型配对及制度内所有可能的模型进行整合。最优断点最大化这一边际似然。将该方法应用于1963年至2023年月度数据中的六个Fama-French因子，分析识别出三个断点——1982年、1998年和2009年——并观察到1998年后模型趋向更简洁。1998年前，选择五或六个因子，但之后仅选两个。因此，随着断点的出现，模型转向简约，这对因子动物园文献具有启示意义。此外，在每个制度内，所有被省略的因子均被所选因子所涵盖。纳入断点还导致最大夏普比率风险因子组合中的权重分配发生显著变化。
